paper.title_en: Quantum-Corrected Thermodynamics and Phase Structure of AdS Euler-Heisenberg Black Hole
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the thermodynamic behaviour of an AdS black hole arising from nonlinear electrodynamics-corrected gravity, incorporating quantum effects through thermal fluctuations. From the Einstein--Euler--Heisenberg framework, we consider the modified black hole solution and analyse its thermodynamic properties in the extended phase space. Logarithmic and inverse-area corrections to the entropy are obtained, leading to modified expressions for enthalpy, internal energy, Helmholtz free energy and Gibbs free energy. The corrected specific heat exhibits multiple divergences and sign changes, signalling genuine second-order phase transitions and revealing a quantum-stabilized microscopic phase followed by universal macroscopic instability. Our results demonstrate that thermal fluctuations qualitatively restructure the thermodynamic phase space and highlight the dominant role of quantum corrections in governing the black hole stability.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究了AdS欧拉-海森伯格黑洞的量子修正热力学性质，包括熵修正、相变和稳定性分析，与黑洞热力学主题高度相关，且具有理论深度。
decision.title_zh: 量子修正的AdS欧拉-海森伯格黑洞热力学与相结构
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了由非线性电动力学修正引力产生的AdS黑洞的热力学行为，并通过热涨落纳入量子效应。从爱因斯坦-欧拉-海森伯格框架出发，我们考虑了修正的黑洞解，并在扩展相空间中分析了其热力学性质。获得了熵的对数和逆面积修正，从而得到焓、内能、亥姆霍兹自由能和吉布斯自由能的修正表达式。修正的比热表现出多个发散和符号变化，表明存在真正的二级相变，并揭示了量子稳定的微观相随后出现普遍的宏观不稳定性。我们的结果表明，热涨落定性重构了热力学相空间，并强调了量子修正对黑洞稳定性支配作用。
